MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell and camera bundle feels useful because it would add home monitoring alongside my recent Echo devices and earlier door alarm.",
    "The Blink Mini cameras also fit my interest in Alexa-compatible home monitoring, although I would choose the broader doorbell bundle this time."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Older Echo Dots and Echo Shows offer little right now because I recently bought newer versions, including a stand for my Echo Show 5.",
    "The Fire TV Stick duplicates the streaming device in my recent gaming bundle; the tablets and car Alexa device address needs I have not shown.",
    "The iPad keyboard case requires a specific tablet I have not indicated owning, and my recent Bluetooth keyboard purchase does not establish that need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My recent Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any Alexa device, regardless of whether it adds a useful function.",
    "My interest in computer peripherals seems to have been stretched into interest in a device-specific keyboard case without evidence that it fits my equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show which needs I have already filled, especially smart displays, speakers, streaming hardware, and keyboards.",
    "Buying a stand for my Echo Show suggests interest in making an existing device more useful, while the camera bundle offers a new capability instead of another similar device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home devices but miss the distinction between adding useful capabilities and duplicating equipment I recently bought."
}
